Name: Pokemon Wonder Mail
Author: januarywren
Description:
[center]Hi everyone! If you love Pokémon, this mod is for you! It is a companion mod to 'Pokemania - The Return' by TheKrominator that adds Pokémon throughout Pelican Town! 
[quote][i]"Dear [Player],

Thank you for subscribing to the 'Wonder Mail' magazine! Wonder Mail is dedicated to celebrating the incredible world of Pokémon that reside within Pelican Town, and beyond.

A new issue will arrive every week with true facts that even an experienced Trainer may not know (such as the fact that Haunter lick their prey to death, or that Tangela vines taste like a delicious savory herb)!

Your first issue will arrive soon - so keep an eye out!

From, The Wonder Mail Team[/i][/quote]
[color=#b4a7d6]Mod Content[/color]

Facts range from the amusing (Flareon will only eat their food well-done! Even if they eat Poke berries, they will breathe fire on them until they are heavily charred) to the unusual the unusual (Willie once found an island where only giant Pokémon roamed!) to the downright terrifying (Trubbish smell so bad that if a person encounters them, they will end up hospitalized!). 

All facts were taken from the official Pokémon website and Bulbapedia. Many of the letters incorporate official facts while fitting the Pokémon within Pelican Town (such as a warning to avoid the Dusknoir that lurk in the caves!). 

Letters are scheduled to arrive on the [color=#ea9999]7th, 14th, 21st, and the 28th![/color]

For *6+ in-game years* the letters will be unique (regardless of when the mod is downloaded - i.e., if you install the mod in your 5th in-game year, then you'll receive unique letters until your 11th in-game year.). 

[color=#ea9999]Required Mods

[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12065]Pokemania - The Return by The Krominator[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod﻿[/url]﻿

[color=#d5a6bd]Mod Compatibility[/color]

This mod shouldn't clash with other mods however Mail Framework Mod will [b]*not*[/b] work with FeTK and Tool-Upgrade Delivery Service. 

[color=#ea9999]Credit
[/color]
I couldn't have made this mod without the help of Emhx, who knows more about Pokémon than Logan Paul ever will. 

And thank you, TheKrominator, for allowing us to create this companion mod to 'Pokemania - The Return'! 

[color=#b4a7d6]About Me[/color]

Hello! My name is January. I've loved writing ever since I can remember, as well as video games and modding. Modders, you guys are the best! I couldn't play Stardew Valley or Skyrim without you. Same to you, indie devs! 

If you are looking for a writer/editor for your modding projects, please send me a message! 

[url=https://januarywren.carrd.co/]My Portfolio[/url]﻿ | [url=https://januarywren.tumblr.com/]My Tumblr [/url][/center]
